referenceFunction.generalComment: Refers to 1 kg dry matter of fresh gras from intensive IP production with 1.66 kg CO2 and 17.9 MJ per kg dry matter. The dry matter content of fresh gras is about 10-15% ; UUID: 7521559b-1ba5-3113-88de-95a1effa5532
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventories include the cultivation of gras on a temporary meadow. Included steps are soil cultivation, pestizides against Rumex, fertilisation (slurry and mineral fertilizer), harvest, loading for transport.
referenceFunction.localName: Grass from meadow intensive IP, at field
referenceFunction.name: Grass from meadow intensive IP, at field

geography.text: Refers to a production in the Swiss plateau (lowlands <700m).

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Data were compiled from statistics, fertilising recommendations, documents from extension services and expert knowledge.
